items.title: "Papa Jack" Laine Interview, 1964-04-25
items.q: I had this man, La Rocca, in the band. Nick La Rocca? He played with me, too.

ctx.x: And I'll tell you, it was one night. How I come not to go up there, it was another political parade I was playing. And I had this man, La Rocca, in the band. Nick La Rocca? He played with me, too. I'd pick up La Rocca when he hardly heard anything about it, Trumper. And I'm playing the music on the street. Some fellas stepped in and was told to me after.
I'll ask Paul. I'll ask Paul.

items.title: "Papa Jack" Laine and Mrs. "Papa Jack" Laine Interview, 1960-05-23
items.q: I'm only saying this because it's so safe. It was told to me... I'm not saying that I know about this, but it was told to me.

ctx.x: How they can tell such a thing?
Well, all the time, most of all, Nick used to come with Manuel Marlowe. And Manuel Marlowe used to show him how to finger and all that stuff and break him in on these...
And he had a number of all of them. On these numbers, you understand?

items.title: "Papa Jack" Laine and Mrs. "Papa Jack" Laine Interview, 1960-05-23
items.q: Poor Nick LaRocca never played no funeral. He couldn't play a funeral.

ctx.x: And I'll give it to him. He give it to him in no... No. That was Arnold Leuco. Arnold Leuco, yeah.
Poor Nick LaRocca never played no funeral. He couldn't play a funeral.
He knows Arnold Leuco knows that the Rocker didn't.
